description: This file defines a helper class '_parse_lockinfo' used for parsing LOCK request bodies in a WebDAV server implementation. It reads and processes XML input stream to extract lock type, scope, and owner information.

classes.name: _parse_lockinfo
classes.description: A helper class for parsing WebDAV LOCK request bodies, reading XML from a stream, and extracting lock type, scope, and owner information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser, reads from a stream file, and parses XML to set lock parameters.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of XML tags, sets lock type and scope, and begins collecting owner info.

methods.name: _data
methods.description: Handles character data within the <owner> tag.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of XML tags, finalizes owner collection, and updates flags.
